description: Create a Docker compose backup archive for all services or one service. Volumes are read while the containers run, so a database mid-write can land inconsistent; an archive is not evidence it restores, which is what backup_drill answers

exclude.description: Host paths not to archive, covering bind mounts at or under each one. What was excluded is written into the archive manifest, so a later restore can tell a mount that was left out from one that never existed (optional)

server.description: Remote server name from config (optional, runs locally if omitted)

name: backup_create
